name: Razorfen Downs (Classic)
summary: The Scourge now holds Razorfen Downs, the quilboar's ancestral burial ground and capital in the southern Barrens. Amnennar the Coldbringer leads its agents, who have raised the quilboar dead and threaten to spread their power across central Kalimdor.

sections.title: Capital of Thorns
sections.body: Razorfen Downs rises among the towering, petrified vines shared with nearby Razorfen Kraul. Here the boar demigod Agamaggan fell in the War of the Ancients. For generations, the thorn labyrinth served as the quilboar's sacred burial ground and seat of power, watched over by mystics of the Death's Head tribe. The quilboar hold its dense briars holy, for their divine progenitor's blood soaked them.

sections.title: A Scourge Bastion in Kalimdor
sections.body: The Scourge has broken Razorfen Downs' sanctity. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a powerful lich in the Lich King's service, subdued the Death's Head quilboar and made their ancestral resting ground an undead stronghold. Reanimated quilboar skeletons and corpses prowl the Spiral of Thorns alongside shrieking banshees. The Horde in the nearby Barrens and emissaries from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light both see this Scourge power as a grave threat to Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Razorfen Downs cuts through massive briars in the southern Barrens. It is the quilboar's ancestral capital and burial ground, now held by the Scourge.

faq.q: Why are there undead inside a quilboar city?
faq.answer: Amnennar the Coldbringer, a Scourge lich, invaded Razorfen Downs, subdued the local Death's Head tribe, and raised dead quilboar to make an undead stronghold on Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the difference between Razorfen Downs and Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul and Razorfen Downs share Agamaggan's brambles. Charlga Razorflank leads the living quilboar stronghold at Kraul, while the Scourge holds the Downs, their ancestral burial ground.

faq.q: Who rules Razorfen Downs right now?
faq.answer: Amnennar the Coldbringer, a Scourge lich, commands Razorfen Downs from deep within the Spiral of Thorns.

angles.text: A Scourge stronghold on the Barrens' southern border threatens the Horde's heartland and supply routes.
As an undead, you may draw the Royal Apothecary Society and Undercity's Forsaken leadership to investigate and purge the rival necromantic magic growing within the Downs.
